title: Browser Extension and Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser: what each is, desktop and mobile
aliases: Browser Extension for Zero Trust Browser

prose.label: Getting them.
prose.text: {{availability-contact}} Configuration, platform versions and licensing are open {{gap:config-and-licensing}}.

checks.do: Whether the lightweight agent is installed alongside the extension when device posture, screenshot protection or keystroke logger protection is expected.

extension-purpose.statement: Browser Extension for Zero Trust Browser is a lightweight solution that enhances existing browsers with browser detection and response (BDR) and data loss prevention (DLP) capabilities.

quotes: Browser Extension for Zero Trust Browser is a lightweight solution providing seamless and secure enterprise access from any browser.
The extension enhances existing browsers with browser detection and response (BDR) and data loss prevention (DLP) capabilities.

extension-features.statement: Browser Extension supports Adaptive App Access (device posture enforcement), Browser-Based Threat Protection and Data Exfiltration Prevention (including screenshot protection and keystroke logger prevention).

quotes: Adaptive App Access: Enforcement of device posture controls to ensure that only compliant devices can access sensitive business applications.
Browser-Based Threat Protection: Robust defense against malicious extensions, identity-based attacks, and emerging web threats.
Data Exfiltration Prevention: Advanced security controls, including screenshot protection and keystroke logger prevention.

extension-agent-required.statement: Device posture controls, screenshot protection and keystroke logger protection require a lightweight agent installed along with the extension.

quotes: Device posture controls, screenshot protection, and keystroke logger protection require a lightweight agent to be installed along with the extension.

availability-contact.statement: Browser Extension and Enterprise Browser are obtained by contacting Zscaler Support, with deployment information at deployztbrowser.com/docs for Browser Extension; the Enterprise Browser for Mobile article directs readers to the Zscaler Account team to learn more.

quotes: To get Browser Extension, contact Zscaler Support.
For deployment information, refer to https://deployztbrowser.com/docs/.
To get Enterprise Browser, contact Zscaler Support.
To learn more about Enterprise Browser for Mobile, contact your Zscaler Account team.

enterprise-browser-definition.statement: Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser is a dedicated, hardened Chromium browser for SaaS applications and private web, RDP, SSH and VNC applications.

quotes: Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser is a dedicated, hardened Chromium browser that protects users from everyday browser-based threats and allows them to securely access SaaS applications and private web, Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), SSH, and Virtual Network Computing (VNC) applications.

enterprise-browser-mobile-platforms.statement: Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser is available as a native mobile application for iOS, iPadOS and Android, on personal or corporate phones and tablets.

quotes: Enterprise Browser for Zero Trust Browser is available as a native mobile application for iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
On a personal or corporate phone or tablet, the Enterprise Browser mobile app provides a governed workspace

enterprise-browser-mobile-capabilities.statement: The mobile app applies URL, category and content policy to each page and lets users request time-boxed exceptions, governs copy and paste at the browser boundary, evaluates device posture before opening a protected application and restricts screen capture and recording inside the app.

quotes: Applies URL, category, and content policy to every page a user opens
users can raise a time-boxed exception request for administrator review.
Governs copy and paste at the browser boundary.
Evaluates device posture before a protected application is opened, and restricts screen capture and screen recording inside the app

enterprise-browser-mobile-input-output.statement: The mobile app inspects what users type into web forms with outcomes of allow, warn, block or mask, applies guardrails to generative AI prompts, uploads and clipboard transfers, restricts printing from sensitive applications and watermarks browser sessions.

quotes: applies the policy outcome, which can allow, warn, block, or mask the content
Prompt content, file uploads to AI services, and clipboard transfers into AI tools are all subject to policy
Restricts printing from sensitive applications and watermarks browser sessions for improved accountability and traceability.
The watermark identifies the signed-in user
